candidates.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. ONE transparent ancient city gate map sprite. PRIMARY REQUIREMENT is accurately projected ground geometry: imagine a 1536x1536 canvas. Ground contact exterior LEFT corner (200,760), FRONT corner (1000,1160), RIGHT corner (1320,1000), hidden REAR corner (520,600). Ground frontage vector +(800,400), ground depth vector +(320,-160). Both axes have exact 2:1 dimetric slope +0.5/-0.5. This is an orthographic parallel camera at yaw45 elevation30; NO perspective. Do not draw these points or any markings. Two end gate piers, each with a 2-unit-wide by4-unit-deep plan, touch this plane. The first front pier base occupies LEFT(200,760) to(360,840), empty passage spans(360,840) to(840,1080), second front pier base spans(840,1080) to FRONT(1000,1160). Both piers extend back/up-right by(320,-160): each pier is visibly twice as DEEP as its front width. Whole footprint10 wide by4 deep; central opening6 wide by4 deep. Front 2:6:2. The three ratios and geometry must be visible and physically correct, ground depth is substantial.
SUBJECT: anonymous 11th–13th century Liao/Jin northern Chinese timber gatehouse bridging two ochre-grey rammed-earth rectangular piers. Only limited grey brick/stone footings and corners. Broad restrained grey clay tile hipped roof, dark matte brown timber columns and heavy bracket sets, modest open/wood-lattice upper hall. No monumental Ming arch or Qing colored decor. The low timber hall spans the 6-unit open passage. Complete isolated building, medieval northern earth-town. Realistic matte historical game sprite with fine weathered timber grain, ceramic tiles, earth strata, grey stone blocks. Detail density comparable realistic isometric Song Chinese town kit, no cartoon. Lighting from upper left, tiny right-lower contact shadow.
The ground contact footprint is the exact parallelogram above, not a long thin facade. Piers vertical, no thick continuous pedestal, no floor/soil island joining the two piers, no water, no landscaping, no steps. Open passage genuinely transparent under the hall all the way through. True RGBA transparency, no fake background checkerboard. Generous margins, entire feet and roof uncropped. No characters, faces, writing, numbers, signs, branding, watermark, lines, arrows, grid, modern objects. ONE gate only.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the GEOMETRY of this one gate. Keep the same realistic grey tile, matte northern rammed earth, plain timber, restrained brackets, upper-left illumination, transparent RGBA. Change only geometry to an accurate orthographic 2:1 dimetric gate. No new decoration.
The CENTRAL OPENING is too narrow. The two front piers are too wide. NARROW each pier's front width by about ONE THIRD, moving its interior face outward towards the exterior. Keep external footprint width 10, depth4, and make central OPEN passage precisely SIX units wide. Two piers are precisely TWO units wide each, depth FOUR each. In front width the three sections must be 20% solid / 60% empty / 20% solid, not 33/34/33. Each pier must be TWICE AS DEEP as it is wide. Deep slender piers, generous broad empty passage.
Change camera so ground frontage descends exactly1 pixel for each2 pixels right, and the depth edge ascends exactly1 pixel for each2 pixels right. Both axes slope +0.5/-0.5, no perspective. The front direction is presently too shallow. Increase camera elevation and make the two ground axis slopes exactly symmetric. Parallel masonry courses throughout. On a1536 square image the ground EXTERIOR corners can be LEFT(200,760), FRONT(1000,1160), RIGHT(1320,1000), hidden REAR(520,600). Front pier first ends at(360,840), next pier starts at(840,1080), so the clear opening spans(480,240) screen vector. Piers each(160,80) front and(320,-160) side. These coordinates are construction guides; draw no labels or lines. Front/depth horizontal run ratio800:320=2.5. Do not use facade oblique perspective.
Preserve full original-like silhouette detail but build to these base proportions. No continuous floor, platform, stairs or earth island. Transparent open gate below the hall, no door. No text, numbers, plaque, watermarks, human or faces, backgrounds, modern elements or diagrams. Complete feet and eaves, generous transparent margins. One gate only.
